title: Mother with Baby & Daughters Portrait, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage sepia snapshot capturing a mother seated in a backyard setting holding a 7-week-old baby wrapped in a blanket, flanked by her two young daughters. The girl on the right wears a hair bow. Handwritten in green ink on the lower front margin is '7 Weeks'. The scene is framed by trees and a modest residential building in the background, typical of early 1930s family documentation.
